title: Unify command list lifecycle and fence flow; remove early-return resets
motivation: Logs show: 'ExecuteCommandList: allocator was reset after the command list was recorded' and subsequent device removal. In renderFrameDXR(), there are early-return paths that Close() without Execute, then next frame Reset()s the allocator. This violates D3D12 rules and triggers removal.
deliverables: Render paths (DXR or fallback) do not early-return after Reset; all paths funnel to a single Close→Execute→Present→Signal block
If DXR prerequisites (PSO/SBT/TLAS) are missing, skip DXR work but continue to Composite path
No command list is left recorded-but-unexecuted when allocator is Reset next frame
Add guards so SetPipelineState1/DispatchRays are only called when PSO != nullptr
acceptance: Debug layer no longer reports allocator reset or 'command list must be closed' errors
No device removal in first minute of execution
PIX shows exactly one Close and Execute per frame
implementation: Refactor renderFrameDXR() into phases: BeginFrame (wait/reset), OptionalUpdate (particles), OptionalDXR (guarded), Composite, EndFrame (close/execute/present/signal)
Replace early return 'Close(); return;' sites with booleans to skip DXR and continue
On any error, flush info queue, still close/execute an empty list (optionally just close and execute a no-op) to keep allocator lifecycle consistent
Verify waitForFrame()/signal uses per-backbuffer fence values correctly
test_plan: Run Debug; ensure no allocator reset messages
Use PIX to inspect per-frame command list Close/Execute counts
Intentionally force DXR PSO failure; app should still render fallback without device removal
